## Install

1. Download **JiraBar-__VERSION__.zip** below, unzip it and drag **JiraBar.app** into **Applications**.
2. The app isn't notarized by Apple. Run this once in Terminal, then open the app:
   ```bash
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/JiraBar.app
   ```

Requires **macOS 14+** on **Apple Silicon**. First-time setup (Jira token, optional free AI key) is described in the [README](https://github.com/mvahedii/jira-bar#first-time-setup).

SHA-256: `__SHA__`
